name: The Black Water
summary: The lake water has turned black, and the fish and birds are dying.
detail: The poisoning starts upriver of Isthmus Town and follows the old mill race toward Deadmill.
found_at: East Lake and the river road
reveals: Something under Deadmill is poisoning the water.

name: Aldra's Lantern
summary: A Tideborn lantern that still smells of lake water, found in the closed butcher shop.
detail: Aldra carried it upriver the night he vanished, and the wick was trimmed for a long walk.
reveals: Aldra was investigating the poisoned water when he disappeared.

name: The Hidden Tithe Record
summary: A second ledger in the Stuffed Inn's cellar, showing a shortfall in the town's tithe.
detail: The record in the inn does not match the one Reeve sent to the Cities. Jandy's route and the missing silver can be traced from it.
reveals: Reeve Trellis has been hiding the true tithe record.

name: The Gate Mark
summary: A black spiral cut into the mill wheel and the stone under Deadmill.
detail: The mark matches the old Tideborn warnings about the Roots and the sealed Gates.
reveals: The cult is trying to open a Gate under the mill.

name: The Vessel for Vuk
summary: Annafranax has prepared a living vessel for Vuk's return.
detail: The Eye of Vuk and the old rites can move Vuk's will into a new body. Fasha is the chosen vessel.
found_at: The White Tower and the temple
reveals: Vuk intends to return in Fasha's body and take the lakes.
